issues.display_title: Issue #497: Hide area label when the area has no name yet (no "unknown" chip)
issues.main_description_html:
Feedback #479.

Description

In the editor 3D view, an area whose name has not been set yet renders a label chip reading unknown (see screenshot in #479). Source: roomName(code) in src/lib/floorplanEditor/floorplan/rooms.ts:16 falls back to "unknown" when the room code is 0 and no custom name override exists; detectRooms() (rooms.ts:315) passes that placeholder through, so the area-label renderer draws it as if it were a real name.

Requested behavior: if an area has no name yet, render no label at all — suppress the chip instead of showing the unknown placeholder. Once the user sets a name, the label appears as usual.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Unnamed areas render no label chip in the editor 2D/3D views and preview — the text unknown never appears on the map
  • Areas with a detected name (ROOM_NAMES / room N) or a custom name keep current label behavior unchanged
  • Setting a name on a previously unnamed area makes its label appear immediately
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green

Assigned to: Muhamad Rifky — Developer

issues.display_title: Issue #503: Align embed postMessage contract with gothru-maps (PANO_CHANGE) for tourmkr minimap sync
issues.main_description_html:
Context

The 3D floormap will be embedded on tourmkr.com as a minimap with two-way panorama sync (tour changes pano → floormap selects the matching point; floormap marker click → tour moves to that pano). The bridge already exists and works (src/lib/preview/tourBridge.ts + src/lib/preview/tourSync.ts + src/components/editor/preview/useTourSync.ts, wired into /embed/[key] via PreviewOverlay), but it speaks a custom contract (select-panorama / panorama-changed). tourmkr already speaks the gothru-maps contract — the floormap must use exactly the same message types.

Reference implementation (gothru-maps-frontend):

  • Inbound src/components/main/maps/container/main/PostMessage.tsx — { type: "PANO_CHANGE", data: <panoId> } (data is the bare pano id) and { type: "ANGLE_CHANGE", data: <degrees> }
  • Outbound src/helpers/postMessage.ts + ModerationMapEvents.tsx — window.parent.postMessage({ type: "PANO_CHANGE", data: { panoId: Number(panoId), tourKey } }, ...) on marker click

Description

Change the message contract in src/lib/preview/tourBridge.ts (and its consumers/tests) to match gothru-maps exactly:

  • Inbound (tour → floormap): accept { type: "PANO_CHANGE", data: <panoId> } — bare id in data, tolerate number or string — and apply it as the current panorama-changed path does (match marker by panorama id → set active + center). Drop the { source: "gothru", type: "panorama-changed" } shape.
  • Outbound (floormap → tour): on marker selection post { type: "PANO_CHANGE", data: { panoId, tourKey } } instead of { source: "mapthru", type: "select-panorama" }. panoId numeric like the reference; tourKey from the imported tour if available (flag it in the PR if the embed context has no tour key to send).
  • Keep the LoopGuard — the type is now identical in both directions, so echo suppression matters more, not less.
  • Fix the origin allowlist while touching the bridge: GOTHRU_TOUR_ORIGINS only has https://tourmkr.com and https://gothru.co. gothru-maps also allows https://www.tourmkr.com, https://tourmkr.app, https://www.tourmkr.app, https://www.gothru.co — mirror that list, otherwise embeds on the www domain silently drop every message. Also correct the misleading comment in useTourSync.ts claiming the referrer origin is accepted at runtime (it is only used as targetOrigin).

ANGLE_CHANGE (camera direction) is out of scope here — separate task if the minimap needs a direction indicator.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Inbound { type: "PANO_CHANGE", data: <panoId> } (number or string) from an allowed origin selects + centers the matching marker in /embed/[key]
  • Floormap marker selection posts { type: "PANO_CHANGE", data: { panoId, tourKey } } to the parent window
  • No select-panorama / panorama-changed shapes remain
  • Loop guard still prevents ping-pong (tour echoing our own PANO_CHANGE back is a no-op)
  • Origin allowlist covers tourmkr.com/tourmkr.app/gothru.co incl. www variants; unknown origins still rejected
  • Unit tests in src/lib/preview/__tests__/ updated to the new shapes
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green

Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

RESULT

Bridge contract replaced with gothru-maps' exactly (commit cfd11d9, branch feature/503-align-embed-postmessage):

  • Inbound { type: "PANO_CHANGE", data: <panoId> } — bare id, number or string; falsy id (0/"") is a no-op like the reference. The outbound { panoId, tourKey } object shape also parses so echoes hit the loop guard.
  • Outbound { type: "PANO_CHANGE", data: { panoId: number, tourKey } } on marker selection; tourKey resolved from Information.pano.tourKey (empty string when absent).
  • select-panorama / panorama-changed shapes removed entirely.
  • LoopGuard kept — echo of our own selection is swallowed.
  • Origin allowlist widened to www.tourmkr.com, tourmkr.app, www.tourmkr.app, www.gothru.co (+ existing tourmkr.com, gothru.co); misleading referrer comment in useTourSync.ts corrected (referrer only picks targetOrigin, never joins the allowlist).

Files: src/lib/preview/tourBridge.ts, src/lib/preview/tourSync.ts, src/lib/preview/panoMarkers.ts, src/components/editor/preview/useTourSync.ts, tests in src/lib/preview/__tests__/.

Verification: pnpm test 614 passed, pnpm lint clean, tsc --noEmit 0 errors in src (remaining errors are pre-existing .next/dev artifacts, present on a clean tree).

Follow-up (commit 00d59b5)

Two embed-sync fixes from testing against the tour player:

  • Info card was only hidden on /embed/[key]; a GoThru tour iframing the live /v/[key] url still showed it. Added isGothruTourReferrer() — the card now also hides when iframed with a GoThru tour referrer; other sites iframing the live view keep it.
  • Inbound PANO_CHANGE only matched markers on the active floor and centered with a ground-locked flyTo. resolvePanoMarkers now resolves every level (active first), the sync switches to the marker's floor (like a search pick), and the camera flies with elevation at the floor's base height (setCenterClampedToGround(false), MapLibre 5) so a floor-4 pano is focused at its own height instead of the ground under it.

issues.display_title: Issue #507: Embed sync fixes: hide info card in tour frames, focus panorama on its own floor
issues.main_description_html:
Follow-up of #503, from testing /embed/bVeiASGM against the tour player.

Description

Two embed problems:

  1. The info card was only hidden on /embed/[key]; a GoThru tour iframing the live /v/[key] url still showed it. The tour owns info display, so the card must hide there too.
  2. Focusing a panorama did not work for upper floors: an inbound PANO_CHANGE only matched markers on the active floor, and the camera used a ground-locked flyTo — a floor-4 pano either didn't resolve or the camera aimed at the ground under it. Marker/selection fly-to had the same problem.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Info card hidden when iframed with a GoThru tour referrer (any route); plain websites iframing /v keep the card
  • Inbound pano on a non-active floor switches to that floor, highlights the marker, and centers at the floor's altitude
  • Clicking a marker on an upper floor centers at the floor's altitude too
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green

RESULT

Done, merged to development and main.

  • 00d59b5 — isGothruTourReferrer() + card hidden in tour frames; resolvePanoMarkers resolves every level (active first), sync switches floors like a search pick
  • 9895d04 — MapLibre 5 gotcha: flyTo/easeTo silently ignore options.elevation; extracted focusPanoCamera() (unclamp → setCenterElevation → flyTo), order locked by unit test
  • 839dc3d — selection fly-to in usePreviewSelectionLayers reuses focusPanoCamera with the active floor's levelBaseHeights

Files: src/lib/preview/tourBridge.ts, tourSync.ts, panoMarkers.ts, src/components/editor/preview/useTourSync.ts, usePreviewSelectionLayers.ts, PreviewOverlay.tsx + tests.

Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

issues.display_title: Issue #508: ?panoId= deep link on /embed and /v: auto-select the panorama and zoom in close
issues.main_description_html:
Description

/embed/[key]?panoId=<id> (and /v/[key]): on load, resolve the marker saved with that panorama id, switch to its floor, highlight it, and fly in close — instead of the default whole-building fitBounds view. Unknown pano id keeps the normal view. The tour sync's own active marker takes over on its first event.

Acceptance Criteria

  • ?panoId=<id> selects + highlights the matching marker on load, on its own floor
  • Camera zooms in close (20.5) at the floor's altitude, keeping the 3D building pitch/bearing
  • Initial fitBounds does not cancel the deep-link camera
  • Unknown/absent panoId → normal fitBounds view
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green

RESULT

Done, merged to development and main.

  • 1c913c5 — initialPanoIdFromSearch() + one-shot deep-link effect in PreviewOverlay (resolve marker → switch floor → focusPanoCamera zoom 20.5 → highlight via MapObjectMarkers activeId)
  • 01b25a8 — deep link claims didFit so the initial fitBounds doesn't cancel the flyTo
  • 1ffa0a4 — deep-link flyTo carries BUILDING_VIEW_PITCH/BEARING (skipping fitBounds had left the camera top-down)

Files: src/lib/preview/tourSync.ts, src/components/editor/PreviewOverlay.tsx + tests.

Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

issues.display_title: Issue #509: Direction destination dots render at ground level instead of the active floor's height
issues.main_description_html:
Description

In Direction mode, the blue destination dots were a MapLibre circle layer — no z axis, always glued to the ground. On an upper floor (e.g. route to "Atap · Floor 2") the dot appeared outside the building at ground level while the route path (drawn by the label canvas at floor altitude) sat on the correct floor. The dots must render on the same floor as the path.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Direction destination dots render at the active level's floor height, aligned with the route path
  • Dots stay visual-only (no click hit boxes) — click behavior unchanged
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green

RESULT

Done, merged to development (51893c1).

  • 838b3bb — dots moved from the ground-locked AREA_DOTS MapLibre layer to the label canvas: new directionDots option in useFloorPlanLabels, projected at levelBaseHeights of the active level, same styling (blue, white stroke). useDirectionMapLayers no longer owns the dots.

Files: src/lib/map/useFloorPlanLabels.ts, useFloorPlanLabels.types.ts, src/components/editor/preview/useDirectionMapLayers.ts, src/components/editor/PreviewOverlay.tsx.

Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer
